title: Grateful Dead Live at Studio- Wake of the Flood Outtakes on 1973-08-01
venue: Studio- Wake of the Flood Outtakes
lineage: Betty Cantor reels > PCM >  DAT > DIO 2448 > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard outtakes of Wake of the Flood with superb performances – Stella Blue, Weather Report Suite and Row Jimmy shine.
ai_review.review: The archive’s soundboard capture delivers studio‑quality clarity that lets every nuance of the mid‑70s Dead shine. Reviewers rave about the emotive guitar work on “Stella Blue,” the soaring keyboards on the Weather Report Suite and the fiery rhythm on “Row Jimmy,” while noting a few weaker moments like the brief “Eyes” and the lackluster “Sing Your Blues Away.” Overall the collection feels vibrant, diverse and technically pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Over two dozen enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both musical performance and audio fidelity; recording is described as crisp/excellent and the show is highlighted as a standout set of outtakes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as superb, crispy, clean and studio‑quality; no dropout or mix issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A cohesive collection of outtakes that mirrors the album’s sequence while revealing raw, alternate takes; listeners note a natural flow despite being studio demos.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for emotive guitar solos on “Stella Blue,” “Row Jimmy,” and an extended solo in “Let It Grow”; noted for his pedal‑steel texture.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted as delivering his best performance on the Weather Report Suite ("Bob's best, imho").
band_member_comments.Keys: Fans comment on funky keyboard work and speculate that Keith may be adding vocal harmonies on “Stella Blue” and “Here Comes Sunshine.”
